issue.description: Build a reusable static PGN analysis app with local Stockfish evaluation, replay, move quality labels, and browser verification. Publish it to chess.jedarden.com through Forgejo, Argo/Cloudflare Pages, and required DNS/custom-domain setup. Keep site copy independent of other chess services. Record verification and deployment references.
issue.notes: Implemented and published static browser chess analysis at https://chess.jedarden.com. App paths: index.html, src/, public/, scripts/, tests/, README.md. Features: PGN input/upload, local Stockfish 19 small network WASM, animated replay, running White-perspective position score, move quality labels, summary, and Agentation. Labels use transparent WDL/centipawn heuristics; no calibrated Elo from one game. Verification: npm ci; node --test tests/*.test.js (5 pass); node scripts/prepare-engine.mjs && ./node_modules/.bin/vite build (pass); headless Chromium against production 68/68 sample positions, +M1 and 34. Qxe8#, replay and flip work, crossOriginIsolated and Agentation true, no page errors, mobile no overflow. Forgejo app commits ca1063ea and 8200be45 mirrored to GitHub. Cloudflare Pages project chess-jedarden-com, custom domain active, DNS CNAME proxied; production deployment d6a01177 succeeded for 8200be45. GitOps in declarative-config commit 0456ea2f, k8s/iad-ci/argo-events/{github-eventsource,website-build-sensor}.yml, iad-ci ArgoCD argo-events-ns-iad-ci Synced/Healthy. GitHub webhook delivery OK, Argo event published, sensor created workflow website-chess-jedarden-com-68lz6. As of 2026-09-21T01:55Z workflow has no phase/pod because shared controller queue is delayed; independent node-remote-2hkmm workflow is also unprocessed. Automated Wrangler run verification remains pending. Final build was deployed directly with Wrangler, so site is live.
